components.summary: Copies a text value to the clipboard from an icon command and confirms the result in place.
anatomy: IconButton (copy glyph → positive check glyph) with a Tooltip → visually hidden polite status region.

api.name: copiedLabel
api.description: Short confirmation shown in the tooltip and announced politely after a successful write.

api.name: label
api.description: Stable accessible name and tooltip, for example "Copy URL".

api.name: value
api.description: Text written to the clipboard. A function reads the current value at press time.

api.name: onCopy
api.description: Called after the clipboard write succeeds.

api.name: onCopyError
api.description: Called when the clipboard is unavailable or rejects the write. The consumer owns recovery messaging.

usage: Supply value (or a function read at press time), label and copiedLabel from locale messages. Core performs the clipboard write, shows the check for a Core-owned 2 seconds and resets.

Use onCopyError to give recovery feedback (for example a danger notification) when the clipboard is unavailable or denied. Do not add a second success toast; the in-place check and status announcement are the single success treatment.
Use a labeled Button instead when the copy command is a primary dialog action that needs visible text.
accessibility: label is the stable accessible name and tooltip; it does not change when copied. copiedLabel is announced through a polite status region after a successful write.
Connect aria-describedby when the copied value is identified by nearby context such as a link row.
constraints: Glyphs, tone, emphasis and confirmation timing are Core-owned; children, tone and visual overrides are rejected.
jsdom tests mock navigator.clipboard. Real clipboard permission behavior and spoken announcements require browser and assistive-technology checks.
